name: What are the biggest mistakes homeowners make in a whole-home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What mistakes cause the most budget overruns and delays in whole-home renovations?
mainEntity.text: What mistakes cause the most budget overruns and delays in whole-home renovations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most renovation problems can be traced to weak upfront planning. Homeowners often underestimate costs, rush into construction before the drawings are complete, or choose products after the work has already begun. Others compare bids that do not cover the same scope, which creates false savings and later disputes. In older homes, failing to inspect hidden conditions can make the project far more expensive once walls are opened. The best way to avoid these issues is to slow down early, define the scope clearly, set realistic allowances, and build in contingency. A well-planned project usually feels slower at the start but moves much more smoothly once construction begins.
acceptedAnswer.description: The biggest mistakes are underbudgeting, starting without enough design detail, choosing finishes too late, comparing incomplete bids, and ignoring hidden conditions in an older home. Poor planning at the start usually leads to delays and expensive change orders later.
